name: Aaria's Blue Elephant
tagline: Building a more inclusive world for kids of all abilities.
description: Aaria's Blue Elephant is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to inclusion for children with special needs across San Joaquin County. We organize adaptive events, social programs, and community resources so every kid gets the place they deserve.

announcements.title: Founding member of the 209 Nonprofit Collective
announcements.body: Aaria's Blue Elephant is proud to be a founding member of the 209 Nonprofit Collective, a vetted network of San Joaquin County nonprofits working together on shared events, resources, and community advocacy.
